title: DriverLocationEvent
description: One driver position on the driver.location topic (key: driverId), published by tracking-service for every accepted location update. Telemetry: sent directly (no outbox), at most once. Mirrors com.rydex.events.DriverLocationEvent. Consumers must ignore unknown fields.

rideId.description: The ride the driver is on (assigned, arrived or in progress), else null.

recordedAt.description: Server time the update was accepted (UTC).
